$comment: Mixer FFmpeg settings from the M4.0b spike (container/audio/README.md §Determinism). plugins/audio-ffmpeg (M4.4) implements them in src/graph.ts and src/render.ts. These produced one PCM hash and one MP4 hash on an Intel and an AMD CI runner and an emulated Apple Silicon host, so no -cpuflags restriction is set.
internal_format: float64 for gain envelopes (aeval), float32 between stages
resampler: aresample with FFmpeg's default swr resampler
measure: ebur128=peak=true, summary parsed on the host

limiter.when: measured true peak + gain > target true peak

pcm_contract.hash: sha256 of the raw interleaved samples

$comment_headroom: M5.1: the AAC encode raised the true peak of a master limited at -1.0 dBTP to -0.9 dBTP. The mixer limits at the profile's true-peak target minus this headroom, so the delivered file meets the target; it is part of the mix key.
